scope: Investigate recovery of GBPUSD BID/ASK ticks for 2026-04-11 → 2026-10-27 to close the Phase 4 broker-window overlap gap.

existing_tick_cache.known_quality_notes: Per 2026-10-27 Phase 2 memo: April 2026 files are mid-only, 2-dp rounded. tz.py codifies the mixed-UTC/EST calibration. The .npy cache is not TZ-corrected; the corrected 52.99 M-row parquet is on the Phase 2 branch.

authorised_additional_sources_scanned: /home/autobot/* — no tick archive outside the Phase 2 corrected cache
findings.ig_rest: The authoritative broker ledger is already extracted via /history/transactions and /history/activity (Phase 4 df8bf63).  IG does not expose historical quote-stream BID/ASK data via REST.

two_validation_modes_retained: HISTORICAL_TICK_REPLAY — supported for 2024-01-01 → 2026-04-10 with the Phase 2 corrected cache + tz.py.
BROKER_EVENT_RECONCILIATION — supported for 2026-09-17 → 2026-10-27 using the Phase 4 ledger; does NOT independently reproduce missing historical price paths.

recommendations: Preserve the two-mode design in the research harness — do not conflate 'simulator replayed a stop' with 'the strategy itself fired against a tick stream'.

If a tick-level comparison on Phase 4's window is required, acquire BID/ASK ticks for 2026-04 → 2026-10 from an authorised third-party source and run them through tz_verify.py before using.  Out of Phase 5 scope.
